lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 105010108 · After Let's Beat Marin chat 1. Clay has invited {AccountData.NickName} to joi…

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Milk!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Just checking in to see

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: if you watched the video 10 times like you're supposed to.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I've watched it eight times so far,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: but it's so boring.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I could recite it with my eyes closed.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Do I really need to watch it two more times?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Of course, you do!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: And that's exactly what we're aiming for;

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: being able to recite it with your eyes closed!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You're doing great, keep it up!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Only two more times to go!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hang in there!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Oh, and starting tomorrow,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I want you to closely follow the schedule that we've made for you.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: So be sure to check the schedule that I sent.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That applies to you too, Coach!
Huh? Me too?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That's right! We're all in this together.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I'll be right there along with you both,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: so neither of you has to worry.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I've just checked the schedule.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Is that even humanly possible?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: It's nothing but practice

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: from morning till the evening.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: It might seem overwhelming at first,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: but if you keep at it, you get used to it.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: In fact,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I went with the most lax schedule of the three options, hehe.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You've got to be kidding me.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: At any rate,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Things are about to get real,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: so you and Pal

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: better be mentally prepared.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Starting from tomorrow, it's gonna be hell!
Why do I have to join...?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hehe, that's the spirit!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I'll be sure to mentally prepare myself as well!
No one's even listening to me...
